newsitem.title: HONG KONG: DC Finance shareholder sells shares.
newsitem.headline: DC Finance shareholder sells shares.

text.p: A major shareholder of DC Finance (Holdings) Ltd has sold nearly one percent of its enlarged issued share capital but has no intention to further reduce his stake, the company said in a statement on Friday.

"Irison Development Ltd, a substantial shareholder of the company and in which Chan Yuen Tung, a director of the company is interested...on April 3, 1997 disposed of 20 million shares in the company representing approximately 3.43 percent of the existing share capital of the company and approximately 1.0 percent of the issued share capital ...as to be enlarged by the bonus issue of the company," the company said.
The shares were sold at a price of HK$1.70.
Irison also sold 6.274 million 1997 warrants at a price of HK$1.70 per warrant. Both were sold to a third party.
Irison said it had no intention to further reduce its stake in the company, which following the bonus issue would be 43.2 percent of the enlarged issued share capital, DC Finance said.
The company earlier this year proposed a five-for-two shares bonus issue.
DC Finance went ex-all on Thursday and closed HK$1.78 lower at HK$1.68.
